beats.text: Hannah spends the afternoon with the giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
💡 The giant rhubarb-like leaves, round burrs, first-year = leaf rosette with no stalk — THAT's what Hannah was describing. Burdock. It clicks like a key turning.
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
Two eyes, forward-facing, unblinking. No wingsound. Owls don't make sound when they hunt — that's the problem.
"We can bind the wounds, or go lean, or hunt hard to replace what we lost. Say which — standing here isn't an answer."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
